Bricks respawn in waves (7→13, then 3, then 3); I've destroyed ~16 total with no completion. So the win condition isn't "clear bricks" or "click cross". sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def blue_bbox(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return None
# align player under pink cross (col 20-22): move LEFT until col0 in [19,22]
for i in range(8):
    bb=blue_bbox(current_frame)
    print("before LEFT",i,"blue col",bb[2],bb[3])
    if 19<=bb[2]<=22:
        break
    action(['LEFT'])
bb=blue_bbox(current_frame)
print("aligned? blue col",bb[2],bb[3],"(target 20-22)")
# now fire ACTION7
r=action(['ACTION7'])
print("ACTION7: bc=",r.get('board_changed'),"reward=",r.get('reward'),"lvl_done=",r.get('level_completed'),"done=",r.get('done'))
f2=current_frame
print("step",f2.step,"level",f2.level)
pink=[n for n in f2.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='P']
print("pink now:", [(n['pixels'],min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])) for n in pink])
print("blue now:", blue_bbox(f2))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
